描述_EN: belts were used to tighten loose robes, mainly to facilitate movement, especially in outdoor activities. in ancient china men and women tied knots to fasten their clothes. this belt buckle is made of very fine jade, which suggests that it was once the property of a man of high status.
描述_ZN: 腰带是用来收紧宽松的长袍的，主要是为了方便行动，特别是在户外活动中。 在古代中国，男人和女人都是通过打结来固定他们的衣服。 这个皮带扣是由非常精美的玉石制成的，这表明它曾经是一个有地位的人的财产。
